summary:

Red today: none of its steps exist, and supervise_brief writes no findings line.
File set: scripts/supervise_brief.py and tests/scenarios/supervision_answers_steps.py.
The feature file, test_supervision.py (bound by scenarios()), and the --change/--accept flag files (w174's) were dropped from the researcher's set.
The findings path is findings.md of the work-item's last <k>-review directory, per r98's Implementation line.
The line goes only in an implementer's brief, and only when the log shows the reviewer's answer route (done -> awaiting-answer -> ready).
The Givens write the ready state, the questions/answers and the log directly; the answers already reach the brief through r57.
No test breaks; open cases are listed in the plan.
